assumptions.data: synthetic (fake) patients; department rules from its answers (21 Sep 2026); booking pattern and arrival habits calibrated on the department's anonymised records (2024-10-15 to 2024-12-31, 3,137 patient-days)
assumptions.reporting: 20 min before the slot; pelvic 45 min (500 mL water, 30 min wait)
assumptions.accessories: 1 breast board, 1 ABC, shared with the CT simulator (11:00-18:00), 2-min transfer
assumptions.imaging_holds: 2% of sessions; half repositioned at once, half treated later the same day
assumptions.current_practice_booking: individual times on a 5-min grid, spread as in the department's records
assumptions.arrival_offset: current practice: the department's recorded arrival habits for an appointment at that hour; RAD-SMART: its recorded morning habits (appointments 08:00-09:59), counted from the reporting time

department_data.source: Department of Radiotherapy, Manipal: anonymised arrival and treatment records (Versa HD), shared by Dr Akshay Dinesan. Aggregates only.

dept_delay.what: treatment minus the later of appointment and arrival

short.label: 45-minute fault at 11:00
short.rule: up to 60 min: nobody is sent home; everyone is treated today with up to 60 min of overtime

long.label: 150-minute fault at 10:00
long.rule: over 60 min: patients are sent back to free what 60 min of overtime and today's gaps cannot absorb; patients not yet travelling are asked to wait for a new time

tbi.manual_taper: at most 2 new starts a day on days 6-13
